lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council work session, where three consequential topics land at once: a deep review of Comprehensive Plan goals, a Gondola Subcommittee update, and — the one worth clearing your schedule for — a look at proposals for a third-party audit of Town rental housing policies. Wednesday adds a BOCC vote that would shift income eligibility at Pinion Park to 80% AMI, quietly redrawing who qualifies for deed-restricted housing in the valley.
